subject: gov.policy
name: Digital Government Transformation Strategy
milestone: Progress update published April 2025
position_start: In force with no published progress account
position_end: Progress reported by the central informatics bureau for the first time on file (2025-04)

subject: gov.policy
name: Digital Mauritius 2030 Strategic Plan
milestone: Published December 2018
position_end: In force as the long-horizon strategic plan, with the 2025-2029 blueprint sitting under it (2018-12)

subject: gov.policy
name: Digital Transformation Blueprint 2025-2029
milestone: Inter-ministerial coordinating committee established, 26 August 2025
position_start: Launched in May 2025, with new digital regulations announced and an inter-ministerial committee established (2025-08)
position_end: Unchanged; no delivery report, milestone or revision has been published against it (2026-08)
sources: 2025-05-01 A Blueprint for Mauritius - Digital Transformation 2025-2029|2025-09-10 Mauritius Digital Transformation 2025-2029 - A Blueprint and New Digital Regulations|2025-09-01 Mauritius Establishes Inter-Ministerial Committee to Drive Digital Strategy|2025-05-26-blueprint-digital-transformation-launch-lexpress

subject: gov.policy
name: Government Programme 2025-2029
milestone: Delivered to the National Assembly, 24 January 2025
position_end: In force as the governing programme for the term (2025-01)

subject: gov.policy
name: National Broadband Policy 2012-2020
milestone: Adopted for 2012 to 2020; no successor policy held
position_start: In force past its own end date
position_end: Still the only broadband policy on file six years past its horizon; spectrum for mobile broadband is being opened by regulator decision instead (2026-06)
note: No replacement broadband policy is held. What has moved since is spectrum, by regulator decision, not policy.

subject: gov.policy
name: National Data Governance Strategy
milestone: Committed to by the ICT minister at the operator's summit, 16 July 2026
position_end: Committed to alongside forthcoming amendments to the Data Protection Act aimed at cybersecurity, privacy and online safety for children; no text, timetable or introduction date is published (2026-07)

subject: gov.policy
name: National Data Strategy 2025-2029
milestone: Launched on World Data Protection Day, 28 January 2026
position_start: Did not exist as a published strategy
position_end: Launched around responsible data governance, cybercrime prevention and online protection of minors, with a memorandum signed between the police, the data-protection office and the national computer emergency team (2026-01)

subject: gov.policy
name: National Fintech Strategy 2026-2030
milestone: Unveiled 25 June 2026 with United Nations technical support
position_end: Six pillars carrying a governance committee, open banking, an artificial-intelligence-in-finance push and a business facilitation bill, implemented with the central bank (2026-06)

subject: gov.policy
name: National Open Data Policy
milestone: Published May 2017
position_end: In force since May 2017; the national data strategy of 2026 is the first instrument to revisit it (2017-05)

subject: gov.policy
name: Sovereign cloud for the Government of Mauritius
milestone: Request for information at its second clarification, September 2025
position_end: At market-sounding stage, with a second clarification issued on the sovereign cloud request for information and a separate scale-out storage tender opened for the government online centre (2025-10)
note: No cloud or data-storage policy instrument is held; the procurement is running ahead of one.

subject: gov.legislate
name: Anti-Money Laundering (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 2026
milestone: Act No. 3 of 2026
position_end: Enacted, amending the financial-crime statute book that governs payment and virtual-asset providers (2026-04)

subject: gov.legislate
name: Atal Bihari Vajpayee Institute of Public Service and Innovation Act 2025
milestone: Act No. 22 of 2025
position_end: Enacted, establishing a public-service training and innovation institute (2025-10)

subject: gov.legislate
name: Business Registration Act
milestone: In force from 1 October 2006, since amended
position_end: In force as the statute establishing business registration (2006-10)

subject: gov.legislate
name: Cadastral Survey Act 2011
milestone: Assented 15 July 2011
position_end: In force as the statute behind the cadastral database and the land administration system built on it (2011-07)

subject: gov.legislate
name: Civil Status Act (Act 23 of 1981)
milestone: In force from 1 January 1982, revised through 2023
position_end: In force as the statute governing birth, marriage and death registration (1982-01)

subject: gov.legislate
name: Customs (Use of Computer) Regulations 1997
milestone: Government Notice 38 of 1997
position_end: In force as the legal basis for computerised customs declaration, made a year before the trade platform it governs (1997-04)

subject: gov.legislate
name: Cybersecurity and Cybercrime Act 2021
milestone: Passed 2021-11-19, assented 2021-11-24, proclaimed in force 2021-12-10
position_end: In force as Act No. 16 of 2021, gazetted as Legal Supplement 567 to Government Gazette No. 173 of 24 November 2021; it is the statute the ministry's own online-content warnings rest on, carrying the offences of misuse of a fake profile (s.16), cyberbullying (s.17) and failure to moderate undesirable content (s.23) with their penalty scales
note: the enacted text as gazetted, held from 2026-08-23; the base previously described the Act only through the ministry's restatements of it

subject: gov.legislate
name: Data Protection Officer Regulations 2026
milestone: Made under the Data Protection Act as Government Notice No. 117 of 2026
position_end: Promulgated, formalising designation, qualifications, independence and reporting duties for data protection officers across public and private sectors, with a six-month compliance window (2026-06); the primary text is now held as Government Notice No. 117 of 2026, made under the Data Protection Act

subject: gov.legislate
name: Economic and Financial Measures (Miscellaneous Provisions) Bill
milestone: Introduced by the Prime Minister and Finance Minister, 24 July 2026
position_end: 119 pages amending 58 Acts and repealing one, with staged commencement from 1 September 2026 and several provisions deemed retrospective, carrying the fintech committee, the AI City Scheme, the central bank threat-sharing platform, the virtual-asset solicitation rule and the digital travel authorisation; introduced, not enacted (2026-07)
note: A secondary account put the figure at some sixty laws; the enacting text gives 58 amended and one repealed.

subject: gov.legislate
name: Electronic Transactions (Amendment) Act 2026
milestone: Act No. 5 of 2026
position_end: Enacted (2026-05)

subject: gov.legislate
name: Electronic Transactions Act amendments
milestone: Referred to by the ICT minister at a postal-sector workshop
position_start: Did not exist as a stated commitment
position_end: Referred to as modernising the digital-commerce framework and consumer protection; no text, timetable or introduction date published (2026-07)

subject: gov.legislate
name: Finance Act 2026
milestone: Act No. 14 of 2026, assented 12 August 2026
position_end: Enacted, carrying the statutory changes behind the 2026-2027 budget's identity, registry and statistics measures (2026-08)

subject: gov.legislate
name: Higher Education (Use of Artificial Intelligence) Regulations 2026
milestone: Government Notice 39 of 2026
position_end: Made, the country's only binding artificial-intelligence instrument, and confined to higher education (2026-04)
note: No general artificial-intelligence statute exists; the national strategy and its guidelines are non-binding.

subject: gov.legislate
name: Income Tax Act
milestone: In force from 1 July 1996, at its ninth issue
position_end: In force as the statute behind the taxpayer register and electronic filing (1996-07)

subject: gov.legislate
name: Mauritius Emerging Technologies Council Bill 2021
milestone: Bill No. VIII of 2021 published
position_end: Published as a bill; no enactment is held (2021-05)
note: Five years on the base carries no evidence the bill was enacted or the council constituted.

subject: gov.legislate
name: Mauritius Meteorological Services Act 2019
milestone: Act 22 of 2019
position_end: In force as the statutory mandate of the meteorological service, including its observation and forecasting functions (2019-11)

subject: gov.legislate
name: Ministerial notice on online-content sanctions
milestone: Communiqué issued 2026-08-17
position_end: A ministry communiqué restating the criminal exposure of online speech and of page administrators who fail to moderate on notice
note: the information technology ministry restated that the Cybersecurity and Cybercrime Act 2021 penalises false profiles (s.16), cyber-harassment (s.17) and the diffusion of undesirable content (s.23), that administrators of accounts, pages and groups must moderate flagged content when a competent authority reports it, and that penalties reach a fine of Rs 1m and up to 20 years' penal servitude. It creates no new obligation - it is enforcement signalling on a law five years old - but it is the first time the base holds the state stating the administrator duty and the 20-year maximum together, and no charge, prosecution or takedown count under those sections is published

subject: gov.legislate
name: Ministerial warning on prosecuting online speech
milestone: Communiqué issued 2026-08-17
position_end: A public communiqué from the ICT ministry warning that online speech can be prosecuted under the Cybersecurity and Cybercrime Act 2021, naming the fake-profile, cyberbullying and undesirable-content offences and defining undesirable content to include material that is deceptive or inaccurate
note: a statement of existing offences rather than a new instrument; no prosecution count is published

subject: gov.legislate
name: National Identity Card Act (Act 60 of 1985)
milestone: In force from 11 April 1986, since amended
position_end: In force as the statutory basis for the identity card and, through the 2024 regulations, for its digital form (1986-04)

subject: gov.legislate
name: National Payment Systems Act 2018
milestone: Assented 29 November 2018
position_end: In force, now at its seventh consolidated version, as the statute under which payment systems and service providers are licensed and supervised (2019-01)

subject: gov.legislate
name: National Research and Innovation Institute Act 2026
milestone: Act No. 6 of 2026
position_end: Enacted, establishing a national research and innovation institute (2026-06)

subject: gov.legislate
name: Protection and Promotion of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2024
milestone: Act No. 1 of 2024
position_end: Enacted as the governing instrument on the rights of persons with disabilities (2024-04)

subject: gov.legislate
name: Public Health Bill 2026
milestone: Consultation workshop held May 2026
position_end: In preparation, put to a stakeholder workshop as the modernisation of public health legislation (2026-05)

subject: gov.legislate
name: Road Traffic (Amendment) Bill: digital driving licence and online penalties
milestone: Provisions set out publicly by the ICT minister, 2026-09-03
position_end: The Bill would give the digital driving licence legal recognition as an official electronic version equivalent to the traditional one, and let holders settle fixed traffic penalties at any court and online; the ICT minister put the affected population at more than 800,000 licence holders, said the digital licence depends on interconnecting transport services, law enforcement and public administration, and said the system will generate up-to-date licence data cross-checked against a central database that officers can consult at roadside checks
note: the Bill text is not held and no enactment or commencement date is stated; the account is the ICT minister's, who frames it as digital transformation rather than road-traffic regulation

subject: gov.legislate
name: Social-media identity verification mechanism
milestone: Consultations announced after Cabinet, 5 June 2026
position_end: Consultations opened toward a verification mechanism against disinformation, impersonation, defamatory content, scams and child sexual abuse material, citing 2,300 online-harm cases from January to June 2026 and frauds up to Rs 500,000; no draft instrument published (2026-06)
note: The minister acknowledged the privacy and free-expression tension, circumvention by virtual private networks, and the need to negotiate with platforms.

subject: gov.legislate
name: Statistics Act 2000
milestone: Independence of the statistics office put in the 2026-2027 budget annex
position_start: In force since April 2001, consolidated with amendments
position_end: In force and under revision: the 2026-2027 budget annex carries the independence of the statistics office, and the 2026 Finance Act amends the statute book around it (2026-06)

subject: gov.legislate
name: Transcription and Mortgage Act
milestone: In force from 1 June 1864, since amended
position_end: In force as the deeds registration statute the electronic registry operates under (1864-06)
note: The registry is digital; its enabling statute is 162 years old.

subject: gov.legislate
name: Virtual-asset solicitation rule
milestone: New section provided for in the omnibus bill introduced 24 July 2026
position_end: Unlicensed solicitation of investors in Mauritius would be prohibited by any medium, defined to reach targeted or algorithmic advertising, platforms, applications, social media, influencers, affiliates, referral codes, seminars and webinars, with any publicly accessible communication presumed to target Mauritius; introduced, not enacted (2026-07)
note: The presumption is the operative part: it shifts the burden onto an offshore promoter to show it was not soliciting locally.

subject: gov.protect
name: Communications interception
milestone: No reform instrument published since the 2025 parliamentary revelations
position_start: Described in Parliament as large-scale interception running since 2017 without judicial oversight, wired into major operators and accessed by counter-terrorism and national security units; no reform instrument on record (2025-08)
position_end: Unchanged: no reform instrument, inquiry outcome or judicial-authorisation requirement has been published, and leaked recordings continue to test the framework (2026-07)
note: The account is a published parliamentary and press one; the Prime Minister confirmed illegal wiretapping, and a volume of intercepted data was reportedly wiped from government servers after the 2019 election.

subject: gov.protect
name: Data Protection Act 2017
milestone: Not among the 58 Acts amended by the July 2026 omnibus
position_start: In force, GDPR-aligned and enforced by an independent office (2025-08)
position_end: Unchanged: amendments were committed in July 2026 with no text, timetable or introduction date, and the Act is not among the 58 Acts the omnibus amends, so the year's expanded inter-agency data sharing arrives with no matching safeguards amendment (2026-07)

subject: gov.protect
name: Data Protection Office enforcement
milestone: Enforcement volume set out at the ID4Africa annual meeting, May 2026
position_start: Independent office enforcing the 2017 Act, with no published enforcement volume (2025-08)
position_end: About 3,000 enforcement actions a year, 99% resolved amicably, chief data officers mandated, and administrative fines being added by amendment (2026-05)
sources: 2026-05-16 World Bank, African DPAs outline formula for trusted digital identity, DPI|2026-05-27-no-digital-id-without-data-protection-madhub-biometricupdate

subject: gov.protect
name: European Union adequacy assessment
milestone: Confirmed as being pursued in 2026 by the data-protection commissioner
position_end: Being pursued with full alignment of the law to the European regulation; no application date, assessment stage or decision is published (2026-05)

subject: gov.regional
name: AFRINIC board and receivership
status: Implemented, board contested and the receiver undischarged
milestone: Appeal set aside for want of corporate authority, judgment of 15 October 2024
position_start: Under an appeal-court order of 15 October 2024 directing the Official Receiver to complete the board election within two months, in substitution for the six months ordered in September 2023; no reconstituted board at the window's start
position_end: The continental internet registry, seated in Mauritius, named a person to all eight board seats on 12 September 2025 while withholding every candidate vote tally its own election guidelines promised; the appeal court then set aside its 28 September 2023 appeal for lack of corporate authority without ruling on the official receiver's permission or on statutory leave, leaving the authority chain from election through appointment to quorum unresolved and the receiver undischarged; the appeal court had directed that the reconstitution be completed within two months of its judgment of 15 October 2024, describing it as a matter of utmost urgency, so the September 2025 appointments came some nine months past that deadline
note: the judgment itself is now held in full; the rest of the account is one outlet's analysis of the registry's own filings, and no registry statement on the withheld tallies is held

subject: gov.regional
name: Convention 108+ (amending protocol)
milestone: Ratified 4 September 2020
position_end: Ratified, the country among the first outside Europe to do so (2020-09)

subject: gov.regional
name: Indian Ocean Commission governance agenda
milestone: Cabinet noted the bloc's 46th summit, August 2026
position_start: Regional cooperation running through the commission with no dated digital agenda
position_end: Active on two regional tracks: collective stewardship of Indian Ocean governance in April 2026 and the southern African bloc's 46th summit noted by Cabinet in August (2026-08)

subject: gov.regional
name: SADC legal instruments programme
milestone: Justice ministers called for signature, ratification and implementation, June 2026
position_end: The regional justice ministers' committee called for enhanced cooperation and for signature, ratification, accession to and implementation of the bloc's legal instruments (2026-06)
note: A call rather than an instrument; which instruments Mauritius has yet to ratify is not stated.

subject: gov.standards
name: Digital Service Framework
milestone: Noted by cabinet 2026-08-28
position_end: a framework noted by cabinet on 28 August 2026 setting mandatory principles and standards binding every government digital service developed, procured or maintained

subject: gov.standards
name: Mauritius Standards Bureau
milestone: Certification mark regulations made April 2026
position_start: Operating as the national standards body, last reporting for 2021-2022
position_end: Two instruments made inside two months: certification mark regulations in April 2026 and minimum energy performance standards for refrigerating appliances in May (2026-05)
note: No annual report later than 2021-2022 is held, so the bureau's current throughput is not on the record.

subject: gov.standards
name: Model-as-a-service certification work
milestone: Collaboration announced by the standards body, 20 July 2026
position_end: Work to define controls and conformance criteria for a certification framework that does not yet exist, with the state operator a founding contributor and co-chair (2026-07)
note: Billed at the operator's summit as a telecom world first; the body's own research finds 72% of operator leaders say they trust their production artificial intelligence and 14% can evidence it.

subject: gov.discourse
name: Mauritius Internet Governance Forum
milestone: 2026 forum held with the Vice President and the ICT minister in attendance
position_end: Convening as a national multi-stakeholder forum founded by the Halley Movement; at its 2026 meeting the Blockchain for Good Alliance and the exchange Bybit met the Vice President and the ICT minister to discuss artificial intelligence, cybersecurity and digital-trust frameworks for small island developing states
note: the record held is the visiting alliance's own press release; no forum programme, outcome document or attendance figure is held

subject: gov.discourse
name: Public argument on what digital investment is for
milestone: Named-analyst argument published 2 August 2026
position_end: The clearest domestic objection on file to the artificial-intelligence-first framing: that contract enforcement rather than technology is the binding constraint, with digitalised case management prescribed alongside a small-claims process and a stronger commercial division rather than instead of them (2026-08)
note: Analysis, not evidence: the World Bank Business Ready indicators and the pending-case count it cites are the study's and the statistics office's, carried dated and not promoted.

subject: finance.budget
name: Budget 2026-2027 tax and revenue measures as enacted
note: The 128-page Finance Bill 2026. Three fetch paths into the National Assembly's bills library returned an HTML shell rather than the document; the library is script-rendered and exposes no static file path, so this needs a browser rather than an automated fetch.

subject: finance.budget
name: Digital and AI measures in the 2026-2027 budget
milestone: Budget presented June 2026
position_end: Artificial intelligence named 35 times, carrying a 50,000-trainee target, a Rs 25m national learning platform, an investment tax credit of 15% a year over three years, a special economic zone of 83 arpents with preferential data-centre power and thirty-year renewable leases, e-gates, e-visa, e-judiciary and a Rs 13m cyber forensic laboratory (2026-06)

subject: finance.mou
name: Interagency Coordination Committee memorandum of cooperation
milestone: Amended memorandum signed March 2026
position_start: A memorandum of cooperation in force among the financial-sector agencies
position_end: Amended and re-signed to strengthen coordination and collaboration among the committee's members (2026-03)

subject: finance.mou
name: Mauritius-India strategic partnership agreements
milestone: Double taxation avoidance agreement ratification approved by Cabinet, July 2026
position_start: A standing bilateral relationship, with a payment link live since February 2026
position_end: Deepened by new agreements in April 2026 and by Cabinet approval of the double taxation agreement's ratification in July (2026-07)

subject: finance.new
name: China Eximbank preferential buyer's credit
milestone: Recorded in the finance ministry's own annual report
position_end: Unchanged; no repayment, drawdown or completion statement has been published (2026-08)
note: US$73.7m, the largest external digital-sector financing on the country's record.

subject: finance.new
name: Cross-border payments gateway business
milestone: Operator figures for 2024 to 2025 reported May 2026
position_end: One gateway reports its Mauritian entity grew transaction volume by over 300% year on year and merchants by 42%, serving over 150 companies, with exit from the financial action task force grey list credited for the confidence (2025)
sources: 2026-05-18 Mauritius emerges as an African payments hub
note: A single company's figures, reported by it.

subject: finance.new
name: Development agency annual report
milestone: 2025 annual report published
position_end: A United Nations development agency's country annual report for 2025, held in full
note: an agency's own account of its year; the digital component is not separately costed in what is held

subject: infra.connect
name: 5G mobile service
milestone: First 5G experience zones opened by the incumbent in July 2021
position_end: Service since July 2021, when the state incumbent opened what GSMA Intelligence calls Africa’s first 5G experience zones on spectrum the state assigned directly to the three operators; coverage reached 86 per cent of the population in 2025 and take-up is projected to move from 9 to 44 per cent, delivered mainly as home internet boxes and in shopping centres, business districts and the university
note: The coverage figure is an industry measure, not a regulator’s published statistic.

subject: infra.connect
name: America-India Connect cable participation
milestone: Non-disclosure agreement signed, terms still under negotiation
position_end: A prime-ministerial commitment to join, behind which sits a signed non-disclosure agreement and unfinished technical, legal and financial negotiation; no consortium confirmation, landing point, capacity, cost or service date is published (2026-08)
note: The operator's own chief executive stayed non-specific on subsea at the same event.

subject: infra.connect
name: International submarine cable landings
milestone: LION and LION2 carrying most international traffic
position_start: Landings on SAFE, LION, LION2 and METISS, with SAFE due to retire around 2027 (2025-07)
position_end: Unchanged in service; LION and LION2 still carry most international traffic and the stated driver for new capacity is infrastructure ageing (2026-08)

subject: infra.connect
name: Internet usage
milestone: 2025 ICT statistics
position_end: Reported in the statistics office's 2025 ICT release, alongside household penetration indicators (2026-07)

subject: infra.connect
name: Mauritius Internet Exchange Point
milestone: Route servers publicly reachable, June 2026
position_start: Launched in August 2015 with African Union support to keep intra-country traffic in country
position_end: Operating with public route servers and a looking glass on both address families; the exchange tracker's snapshot is the only third-party account of its size (2026-06)

subject: infra.connect
name: Mauritius Telecom 2026-2029 strategy
milestone: Four-corridor strategy published, January 2026
position_end: A reported Rs 20bn programme across connectivity, financial services, artificial intelligence and compute, and innovation; no delivery milestone has been published against it (2026-01)

subject: infra.connect
name: Mobile penetration
milestone: 2025 ICT statistics
position_end: Reported in the statistics office's 2025 ICT release, the first such figure the base holds (2026-07)
note: A first observation with no earlier figure held on this ledger.

subject: infra.connect
name: National fibre backbone
milestone: Operator summit set out the connector positioning, December 2025
position_start: The 2030 strategic plan's connectivity pillar, with landings and domestic fibre in place
position_end: In service, the incumbent positioning the island as the natural connector between Africa and Asia at its December 2025 summit; no route length or capacity figure is held (2025-12)

subject: infra.connect
name: Phasing out of 3G mobile services
milestone: Regulator communique of 28 May 2026
position_end: Announced by the regulator, with 2G and 3G spectrum to be re-farmed for newer generations (2026-05)
note: No switch-off date or migration figure is stated in the communique held.

subject: infra.connect
name: Satellite broadband authorisation regime
milestone: Regulator's decision issued 22 May 2025
position_end: Unchanged: service only through a locally licensed provider, a local point of presence with Mauritian-geolocated addresses, real-time terminal dashboards and provider-retained terminal ownership. No satellite service has been authorised under it (2026-07)
note: Domestic experts are divided on relevance given 153% broadband penetration and existing fibre and mobile coverage.

subject: infra.connect
name: Spectrum released for IMT and 5G
milestone: 2300-2400 MHz band opened, June 2026
position_start: 700 MHz opened for testing and operation of IMT networks by decision of 22 December 2025
position_end: A second band opened six months later, the 2300-2400 MHz range, with additional spectrum made available for IMT operation including 5G (2026-06)

subject: infra.connect
name: St Brandon satellite connectivity contract
milestone: Raphael Island connected 2026-08-30
position_end: Raphael Island in the Saint Brandon archipelago connected to the internet
note: the same contractor built the authority's Agalega solution; no service date, capacity or value is stated

subject: infra.connect
name: T4 and SEACOM 2.0 landings
milestone: Named in the operator's 2026-2029 strategy
position_start: Did not exist as a published plan
position_end: Named as planned landings, with T4 to replace the retiring SAFE cable; no contract, cost or date published (2026-01)

subject: infra.connect
name: Tariff intervention on mobile data
milestone: Free monthly mobile data package for young people
position_start: A promotional tariff framework issued by the regulator in August 2025
position_end: A free monthly mobile data package administered through the revenue authority, on top of the regulator's promotional tariff framework (2026-06)
note: No price index or affordability measurement is held; both instruments are interventions rather than measures.

subject: infra.store
name: Carrier-neutral green data centre and Digital Embassy Village
milestone: Announced at the 46th SADC summit 2026-08-17
position_end: Announced as the digital leg of a bid to position the country as a regional digital hub; no site, capacity, cost, operator or date is stated
note: announced by the prime minister at a regional summit, alongside a statement that over US$8.2m of arrears had been paid to the organisation

subject: infra.store
name: Central Backup Service
milestone: Operated by the central information systems division
position_end: In service as the central government backup service, run by the central information systems division (2026-09)
note: A service description page; no capacity, retention period or restoration-test record is published.

subject: infra.store
name: Data-centre estate
milestone: Ten operating facilities across five locations
position_start: Ten operating data centres across Port Louis, Reduit, Arsenal, Quatre Bornes and Rose-Belle, including a carrier-neutral Tier IV-designed site and the internet exchange point (2025-07)
position_end: Unchanged in count; no new facility has been reported since (2026-08)

subject: infra.store
name: Government Online Centre servers, storage and disaster recovery site
milestone: Scale-out storage award notified March 2026
position_start: High-performance servers, a storage area network and a backup solution for the main site and the disaster recovery site at bid evaluation
position_end: Procurement running on two tracks: the servers, storage network and backup solution at bid evaluation, and a scale-out storage solution awarded in March 2026 (2026-03)
note: A disaster recovery site is provided for in the procurement; nothing states whether it is in service.

subject: infra.store
name: Rose-Belle Tier IV data centre
milestone: Certified Tier IV and inspected by the ICT minister, 29 December 2025
position_start: Not established as the sovereign-hosting anchor (2025-08)
position_end: Certified Tier IV and hosting e-health, the government portal, the Mobile ID wallet, the penalty-points licence system and government artificial-intelligence workloads, giving the ageing Government Online Centre the disaster recovery it lacks (2025-12)

subject: infra.energy
name: Electricity demand against generation headroom
milestone: Severe yellow alert on a record 540 MW peak
position_start: A red alert in October 2025 with business urged to cut consumption
position_end: A severe yellow alert triggered after demand reached a record 540 MW peak (2026-03)
note: The alert colours are the utility's own scale; no reserve margin or outage figure is published against them.

subject: infra.energy
name: Electrification and household solar
milestone: Household solar photovoltaic scheme opened for 2026
position_start: Universal electrification with the ministry reporting on network performance
position_end: A household solar photovoltaic scheme opened for 2026 and the Rodrigues executive council deciding electricity extensions in February (2026-04)
note: Rural electrification is not a live gap on the main island; the outer islands are where extension decisions are still taken.

subject: infra.energy
name: Saudi Arabia energy and cybersecurity memorandum
milestone: Cabinet approved the memorandum for signature
position_end: An approval to sign, not a signature: the stated scope puts digital transformation and energy-sector cybersecurity alongside hydrocarbons, with no signing date, term, value or committed system, standard or spend (2026-08)

subject: infra.capacity
name: Domestic technical capacity to operate the national digital estate
milestone: Information security management being advanced across the public service
position_end: Being built rather than held: an information security management system advanced through workshops from March 2026, and the digital government strategy reporting progress for the first time in April 2025 (2026-03)
note: No establishment figure, vacancy rate or retention account for specialist digital posts is held.

subject: infra.capacity
name: Information Security Management System in the public service
milestone: Half-day workshop advancing the system, March 2026
position_end: Being advanced across the public service through a workshop programme (2026-03)
note: No certification, scope statement or completion date is held.

subject: infra.cybersec
name: Critical Information Infrastructure regime
milestone: Designation regulations in force 1 June 2026, with a twelve-month compliance window
position_start: Did not exist; cybercrime was punishable but no framework existed to designate and regulate operators of critical systems (2025-08)
position_end: In force across financial and banking, public service, information technology and broadcasting, energy and water, and transport, with non-compliance carrying up to 25 years' imprisonment and fines up to Rs 2m (2026-06)

subject: infra.cybersec
name: Cyber forensic laboratory
milestone: Funded at Rs 13m in the 2026-2027 budget
position_end: Funded at Rs 13m alongside an information-security management system across the administration; no site, staffing or opening date published (2026-06)

subject: infra.cybersec
name: Cyber Threat Intelligence Sharing Platform
milestone: Provided for in the omnibus bill introduced 24 July 2026
position_end: The central bank would be empowered to establish it and to require financial institutions, and other institutions it specifies, to participate on terms it determines; the bill was introduced and not enacted, and no platform, terms or participant list exists (2026-07)
note: Participation is compulsory and the perimeter is set by the central bank rather than by the cyber authority, and is extensible at the bank's discretion.

subject: infra.cybersec
name: Cybercrime reports against investigator numbers
milestone: Ministry communique covering January to July 2026
position_end: 4,076 cybersecurity and online-behaviour reports between January and July 2026, against a cybercrime unit of seventeen investigators
note: Both figures come from the ministry’s own communique, which is what makes the ratio quotable.

subject: infra.cybersec
name: Postal sector threat sharing
milestone: Capacity-building workshop with the Universal Postal Union, 29 July 2026
position_end: The national postal operator is being wired into the Universal Postal Union's global postal information-sharing centre, and the ICT minister urged adoption of ISO/IEC 27001 as the standard; no membership date or commitment published (2026-07)

subject: infra.cybersec
name: Reported cyber incidents
milestone: Figure given at the schools programme launch, 2026-08-13
position_end: More than 4,000 reported cyber incidents in Mauritius since January 2026
note: the figure is given at a programme launch and no reporting body, definition or comparable earlier period is named

subject: infra.cybersec
name: Telecommunication Directive 2 of 2025 (child sexual abuse content filtering)
milestone: Operational at each licensee by 1 May 2025
position_start: A centralised filtering service run by the regulator since February 2011, which could make an end user's IP address appear to come from an unexpected location
position_end: Issued on 24 March 2025 under sections 17(3), 18(1)(m) and 32(5)(a)-(b) of the ICT Act 2001, the directive moved the four internet service licence holders off the regulator's centralised child-sexual-abuse filter and onto on-premises filtering inside each operator's own network against the Project Arachnid blacklist, by 1 May 2025. It requires non-intrusive filtering with no deep packet inspection, HTTPS blocking only at web-domain level, monthly returns to the regulator of access attempts, blocked local IP addresses and blocked domains, and an annual external IT security audit
note: the instrument settles how the published blocking figures are counted: the 510,132 blocked access attempts reported for January to July 2026 are hit counts against the Arachnid list, not unique users and not confirmed retrievals of the material

subject: dpi.exchange
name: e-Government Interoperability Framework
milestone: Version 1.0 published November 2002
position_start: The standing interoperability instrument, dating from 2002 (2025-08)
position_end: Unchanged; no successor framework is held, and the interoperability commitments of the 2025-2029 blueprint have produced no published instrument (2026-08)
sources: 2002-11-01 Mauritius e-Government Interoperability Framework v1.0|2024-03-01 Enhancing Data-Sharing Practices Between Government Agencies (case study, Sone Osakwe)

subject: dpi.exchange
name: Education system data infrastructure
milestone: Data lake consultancy tendered for the higher education regulator, February 2026
position_start: A national higher education, science and research strategy for 2025-2035 with no data infrastructure in place
position_end: A comprehensive data infrastructure tendered for the higher education regulator, alongside an education platform pilot agreed with the incumbent operator (2026-02)

subject: dpi.exchange
name: Health system data exchange
milestone: Full public-sector coverage targeted for end-2027
position_start: The e-Health programme running with the ministry reporting on its performance for 2024-2025
position_end: Thirteen years in, full public-sector coverage is targeted for the end of 2027, with a modernised public health bill in preparation around it (2026-07)
note: The 2027 target is the programme's own; no coverage figure against it is published.

subject: dpi.exchange
name: InfoHighway data-sharing platform
milestone: Named in the national data strategy as the sharing layer
position_start: In service since 2016 as the platform through which government agencies share data
position_end: In service, and named in the 2026 national data strategy as the arrangement the strategy builds on (2026-01)
note: No count of connected agencies, services or transactions is published.

subject: dpi.exchange
name: Social protection system integration
milestone: Cabinet noted the social register alongside the free-internet measure, February 2026
position_start: A social register decided in Cabinet in March 2009, with no integrated system
position_end: An e-Social Security system tendered in October 2025 for supply, installation, testing, commissioning and maintenance, with the social register used to target the free-internet measure (2026-02)

subject: dpi.exchange
name: Statutory data sharing by the statistics office
milestone: Provided for in the Finance Bill before Parliament, July 2026
position_end: The statistics office would be empowered to share more data with the finance ministry, alongside new declaration duties on public bodies; the bill was before Parliament and its enacting text is not held (2026-07)
note: The expanded inter-agency data sharing arrives with no matching amendment to the Data Protection Act.

subject: dpi.exchange
name: SuperApp on verifiable digital credentials
milestone: KOREK! soft-launched, January 2026
position_start: A request for information issued in September 2025 for a superapp built on verifiable digital credentials in a secure identity wallet
position_end: Soft-launched as KOREK!, after a market sounding whose clarification of October 2025 set the wallet's shape (2026-01)

subject: dpi.id
name: Digital travel authorisation and digital permits
milestone: Provided for in the omnibus bill introduced 24 July 2026
position_end: Permits would become issuable in digital, card or paper form and a digital travel authorisation would be imposed on visa-exempt arrivals, applied for electronically and paid before travel; the bill was introduced and not enacted (2026-07)

subject: dpi.id
name: MauPass national authentication framework
milestone: Independent security audit put out to consultancy, October 2025
position_start: In service as the national authentication framework, unaudited on the record
position_end: In service and put to an independent information-technology security audit, tendered in October 2025 (2025-10)
note: The audit was commissioned; no finding from it is held.

subject: dpi.id
name: Mobile ID wallet
milestone: Launched 4 September 2024 with Thales under the 2024 regulations
position_start: In service; no user or issuance figure published (2025-08)
position_end: In service and hosted on the Rose-Belle facility; still no user or issuance figure published (2026-08)
sources: 2024-09-06 Mauritius Launches Mobile ID Digital Wallet with Thales - First African ISO-standard Digital ID Wallet|2024-01-01 National Identity Card (Mobile ID) Regulations 2024 (Mauritius)|2025-02-06 Smart and Mobile ID in Mauritius - Recommendations for a Balanced Approach
note: A domestic analysis welcomed the wallet's convenience and pressed for privacy and surveillance safeguards around the enabling regulations.

subject: dpi.id
name: National Identity Card Regulations 2024
milestone: Government Notice 29 of 2024
position_end: Made, setting the terms on which the card and the mobile identity are issued and read (2024-02)

subject: dpi.id
name: National Identity Card Unit and its issuing centres
milestone: Office space tendered for a registration and issuance centre at Curepipe
position_start: Registration and issuance running through the unit's existing centres
position_end: Expanding: office space put out to open national bidding in December 2025 for a further registration and issuance centre (2025-12)

subject: dpi.id
name: SIM registration by electronic identity check
milestone: Electronic verification steps published for the re-registration exercise
position_end: Unchanged; no completion or coverage figure is held (2026-08)
sources: 2024-01-01 eKYC Steps for Mauritian Citizen (SIM Re-Registration)

subject: dpi.pay
name: Central bank digital onboarding system
milestone: Set out by the governor at a payments workshop, February 2026
position_end: A know-your-customer system for digital onboarding under construction, alongside alignment to the G20 cross-border roadmap and exploratory work on artificial-intelligence fraud detection; no delivery date published (2026-02)

subject: dpi.pay
name: Guidance Notes on Stablecoins
milestone: Issued by the financial services regulator, August 2026
position_end: Issued as part of the regulator's fintech series, with an annexure (2026-08)

subject: dpi.pay
name: Guideline for Payment Aggregators
milestone: Issued by the central bank, July 2026
position_end: Issued, bringing payment aggregators under a stated supervisory expectation for the first time (2026-07)

subject: dpi.pay
name: India cross-border payment link
milestone: First bilateral cross-border payments agreement, February 2024
position_end: Unchanged; no volume or corridor figure has been published (2026-08)

subject: dpi.pay
name: MauCAS instant payment switch
milestone: Profiled as a mature interoperable rail in the 2024 instant-payments review
position_start: Mature interoperable national rail with a QR standard (2024)
position_end: Unchanged in structure; no national transaction volume has been published (2026-08)

subject: dpi.pay
name: Mauritius-Seychelles payment corridor
milestone: Announced by the state operator at its summit, 16 July 2026
position_end: Announced as launched by the operator; no corroborating record from the partner fintech, the Bank of Mauritius or the Central Bank of Seychelles is on file (2026-07)

subject: dpi.pay
name: my.t money wallet
milestone: Operator's 2026-2029 strategy, January 2026
position_end: Over 130,000 active users, being scaled into a cross-border product under the operator's financial corridor; no transaction figure published (2026-01)

subject: dpi.pay
name: National Fintech Governance Committee
milestone: Put on a statutory footing from 1 September 2026 by the bill introduced 24 July
position_end: Provided for in a new Part IIIA of the Financial Services Act, minister-chaired, seating the central bank governor, the financial regulator's chief executive, two ministries, the investment board and four private-sector members, empowered to approve sector-wide standards and frameworks and expressly not a body corporate; the bill was introduced and not enacted (2026-07)

subject: dpi.pay
name: Retail digital payment adoption at the largest bank
milestone: Bank's 2025 figures reported January 2026
position_end: Cash 27% of consumer spend, QR payments up 67% year on year, contactless above six in ten card transactions and about 18,000 merchants accepting (2025)
note: One bank's figures, not a national series.

subject: dpi.pay
name: SADC real-time gross settlement participation
milestone: Reported as under consideration by a South African Reserve Bank spokesperson
position_end: Reported as considering onboarding the rupee, potentially by end-2027, after the Angolan kwanza became the system's second settlement currency; no Bank of Mauritius statement of its own is held (2026-07)
note: The named next currencies are the Botswana pula and the Mozambican metical, not the rupee; admission is priced on liquidity rather than mandated.

subject: dpi.pay
name: Social Contribution income allowance
milestone: Frequently asked questions published January 2026
position_end: Administered by the revenue authority as a government-to-person payment, with eligibility and payment terms published (2026-01)
note: No payment volume, disbursement channel breakdown or coverage rate is published.

subject: dpi.pay
name: Value-added tax on digital services from foreign suppliers
milestone: Guide for foreign suppliers at version 2.0
position_start: A registration and collection regime for foreign digital suppliers
position_end: In force with a second version of the supplier guide, the revenue authority collecting on digital and electronic services supplied from abroad (2026-01)
note: No collection figure under the regime is published.

subject: dpi.registry
name: Business register
milestone: Quarterly business statistics for the second quarter of 2026
position_start: In service under the Business Registration Act since 2006
position_end: In service, feeding quarterly enterprise-dynamics statistics, with the economic and financial measures bill debated in July 2026 touching its statutory base (2026-07)

subject: dpi.registry
name: Civil registration base
milestone: Civil Status Division performance report for 2023-2024
position_start: Complete civil-registration base underpinning the identity system (2024)
position_end: Unchanged; no later performance report is held (2026-08)
sources: 2024-01-01 Mauritius Civil Status Division Annual Report on Performance FY2023-2024|2019-06-01 The CRVS and Identity Eco-System in the Republic of Mauritius (presentation)

subject: dpi.registry
name: Civil Status Division register
milestone: System revamping announced September 2025; Finance Act amendments August 2026
position_start: The register operating on its existing system under the 1981 Act
position_end: Being revamped, with the division's system replacement announced in September 2025 and the 2026 Finance Act amending the statute around it (2026-08)

subject: dpi.registry
name: Mauritius eRegistry and the deeds register
milestone: Electronic submission of land deeds carried in the 2026-2027 budget annex
position_start: The electronic registry in service under an 1864 statute, with no disaster recovery arrangement on the record
position_end: A disaster recovery solution implemented for the electronic registry in March 2026, and electronic submission of land deeds carried in the 2026-2027 budget annex (2026-06)

subject: dpi.registry
name: National address register
milestone: Addressing identified as a data gap in the national data strategy
position_end: Not held: no national address register exists, and the closest work on file is the verifiable-credential wallet's identity attributes (2026-01)
note: A dated, searched absence. The island's postal addressing is not organised as a state register.

subject: dpi.registry
name: Register of Electors
milestone: Registration communique issued May 2026
position_start: Compiled annually from a house-to-house inquiry under the Representation of the People Act
position_end: Compiled again in 2026 from the statutory house-to-house inquiry, with a public communique on elector registration in May (2026-05)
note: The inquiry is a door-to-door canvass; no digital enrolment route is described.

subject: dpi.registry
name: Social Register of Mauritius
milestone: Named in the 2026-2027 budget as the targeting instrument
position_start: Decided in Cabinet in March 2009 and operating as the register of eligible households
position_end: Used to target the 2026-2027 budget's measures and the free-internet decision of February 2026, with an e-Social Security system tendered to replace the platform beneath it (2026-06)
note: No enrolment figure for the register is published in the sources held.

subject: dpi.registry
name: Taxpayer register
milestone: Tax agent registration guide issued June 2026
position_start: Maintained under the Income Tax Act with registration thresholds set by statute
position_end: Extended in two directions inside a year: a compulsory value-added tax registration threshold changed by the Finance Act, and a registration regime opened for tax agents (2026-06)

subject: dpi.mis
name: Court and justice information systems
milestone: Justice systems carried in the 2026-2027 to 2030-2031 investment programme
position_end: Carried in the public sector investment programme for 2026-2027 to 2030-2031, alongside the e-judiciary component of the digital government package (2026-06)
note: No case-management system, filing volume or rollout figure is held.

subject: dpi.mis
name: Customs declaration and trade systems
milestone: Export procedure under China zero-tariff treatment carried on the trade platform
position_start: Computerised customs declaration in force under the 1997 regulations
position_end: Hosting a World Customs Organization study mission on cloud computing in January 2026 and carrying the China zero-tariff export procedure on the trade platform in May (2026-05)

subject: dpi.mis
name: E-Social Security digitisation
milestone: Bulk scanning of beneficiary files launched, May 2026
position_start: Did not exist; the welfare system had run on paper for thirteen years
position_end: 10.5m social-benefit documents being digitised into a future platform, with full integration stated at about eighteen months; the system carries about 800,000 payments a month to at least 350,000 beneficiaries (2026-05)
note: Social-protection spending was Rs 91.4bn, 12.8% of gross domestic product, in 2024-25.

subject: dpi.mis
name: eHealth strategy
milestone: Seamless Continuity of Care strategy published 2015
position_start: The standing eHealth instrument, dating from 2015 (2025-08)
position_end: Unchanged; e-health workloads are hosted on the Rose-Belle facility but no successor strategy or delivery report is held (2026-08)
sources: 2015-01-01 Health 2015 - Seamless Continuity of Care (Mauritius eHealth strategy)

subject: dpi.mis
name: Fisheries Information System
milestone: Proposal endorsed at a validation workshop 2026-08-18
position_end: A proposal for a national fisheries information system endorsed at a validation workshop convened by the fisheries ministry, for submission under a multilateral fisheries fund's project-implementation grant window
note: a proposal for submission; no award, budget or build is on record

subject: dpi.mis
name: Land Administration, Valuation and Information Management System
milestone: Consultant selection opened for the 2.0 turnkey solution, March 2026
position_start: In service on its first generation under the Cadastral Survey Act
position_end: Being replaced: a consultant selection opened in March 2026 for a second-generation turnkey solution (2026-03)

subject: dpi.mis
name: MRA e-Invoicing system
milestone: Introduced nationally in a phased approach
position_end: In service, introduced at national level in a phase-wise approach by the revenue authority (2023-06)
note: No phase schedule, taxpayer count or invoice volume is published on the page held.

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Airport parking management system
milestone: In full operation from 2026-08-17
position_end: A Rs 50 million system with more than 20 licence-plate-recognition cameras, five self-service payment stations and mobile-wallet payment, replacing the 2013 installation and raising exit throughput
note: a licence-plate-recognition deployment on public premises; no retention period, data controller or privacy assessment is published

subject: dpi.govtech
name: e-Gates, e-Visa and e-judiciary
milestone: Provided for in the 2026-2027 budget
position_start: Did not exist as funded commitments
position_end: Funded in the budget alongside a healthcare innovation and artificial-intelligence unit; no procurement, vendor or delivery date published (2026-06)

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Legal Metrology Information System
milestone: Reported under development 2026-08-10
position_end: An online platform for bookings, payments and certificates is being built to carry commercial-weighing oversight, which verified 12,412 measuring instruments across 4,971 businesses and inspected 4,974 shops in 2025-2026
note: the verification, inspection and revenue figures are the service's own annual figures; no go-live date or cost for the platform is stated

subject: dpi.govtech
name: National electronic licensing system for clinical trials
milestone: Provided for in the omnibus bill introduced 24 July 2026
position_end: Concurrent submission, review and processing of trial applications through a statutory electronic system, with the council and ethics committee empowered to meet virtually and an expedited pathway; the bill was introduced and not enacted (2026-07)
note: The electronic channel and the procedure that runs on it are in the same statute, which makes the channel enforceable against the regulator rather than only convenient for the applicant.

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Online motor vehicle licence and road tax system
milestone: Launched in Port Louis 2026-08-18
position_end: Live for taxi operators, who renew the licence and pay road tax online instead of at post offices and land transport authority counters, and which the ministry states will also build a database of operators; launched alongside a website for the operators' welfare fund, whose membership is 6,567 of 7,802 operators, with about 3,000 operators already on an electronic platform
note: the land transport authority's underlying system is stated as outdated with a tender launched to upgrade it; no transaction volume, cost or extension beyond taxi operators is published

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Single government digital platform
milestone: Cabinet took note of the consolidation plan, August 2026
position_start: A government portal and separate official websites
position_end: Cabinet has taken note of a plan to consolidate the government portal and the separate official websites into a single citizen-centred platform; taking note is not approval, and no budget, supplier or delivery date is on file

subject: digital.localgov
name: Digitalisation of local authorities
milestone: Autonomy and digitalisation agreed for local authorities, February 2026
position_start: Local authorities reporting through ministry annual performance reports with no digital programme named
position_end: A decisive step towards more autonomous and digital management of local authorities taken in February 2026 (2026-02)
note: No platform, budget or timetable is named in the account.

subject: digital.localgov
name: Digitalisation of local government
milestone: Autonomy and digitalisation agreed for local authorities, February 2026
position_end: A decisive step towards more autonomous and digital management of local authorities taken in February 2026, on ministry annual reports that name no platform (2026-02)
note: A district or municipal digital plan or service platform. The Rodrigues Regional Assembly's roadmap is the only sub-national instrument held and it is a territory, not a local authority.

subject: digital.rural
name: Digital learning in primary schools
milestone: Virtual reality programme running in primary schools
position_start: Household ICT penetration reported, with no schools programme on the ledger
position_end: Two programmes running: virtual reality in primary schools, and an education platform launched in January 2026 under the operator pilot (2026-09)
note: No school count or pupil reach is published for either programme.

subject: digital.rural
name: e-Health in area and community health centres
milestone: Electrical works awarded for the second e-Health region, May 2026
position_start: The e-Health programme running without published coverage of the primary-care network
position_end: Electrical works awarded in May 2026 for area and community health centres in the second region, with full public-sector coverage targeted for the end of 2027 (2026-07)

subject: digital.rural
name: Police station digitisation
milestone: Strategic plan for 2026-2028 published
position_start: The force reporting annually on performance with no digital programme named
position_end: Carried in the force's strategic plan for 2026 to 2028, published December 2025 (2025-12)
note: No station count, system name or rollout figure is held.

subject: digital.rural
name: Registry office digitisation
milestone: Registrar-General's annual report for 2024-2025
position_end: Under way: the deeds registry reporting for 2024-2025 and the civil status division announcing a system replacement (2025-10)
note: Mauritius has no rural registry network in the sense the indicator asks about; the offices are a small national estate.

subject: digital.rural
name: Rural digital data capture
milestone: Sector programmes reaching the primary estate rather than a rural programme
position_end: Not a rural programme but four sector ones reaching the primary estate: e-Health works in area and community health centres, virtual reality in primary schools, registry system replacement and a police strategic plan (2026-09)
note: On an island of this size the rural indicators are answered by national programmes; there is no separate rural digital programme and none would be expected.

subject: tech.ai
name: AI City Scheme
milestone: Provided for in the omnibus bill introduced 24 July 2026
position_end: A certified specialised technological and innovation hub promoting artificial intelligence, digital sectors, advanced computing infrastructure and advanced manufacturing, whose certificate carries fiscal incentives, duty exemptions, expedited permits and prescribed property acquisition, with a new AI Founder occupation permit at US$1m invested; introduced, not enacted (2026-07)
note: An incentive and immigration scheme rather than a governance one.

subject: tech.ai
name: AI-enabled water leakage reporting
milestone: Launched on the government superapp, July 2026
position_end: Launched on the government superapp as an artificial-intelligence-enabled reporting service for water leakage (2026-07)
note: The first artificial-intelligence service the base holds inside a citizen-facing government channel.

subject: tech.ai
name: Enterprise artificial-intelligence adoption
note: The results of the adoption, readiness and governance study launched on 27 July 2026 by the chamber of commerce, the outsourcing association and a third partner, commissioned because no picture exists of adoption levels, affected sectors or available skills.

subject: tech.ai
name: Mauritian Creole voice model
milestone: Presented by the incumbent operator 2026-08-16
position_end: Described by the incumbent operator as the first voice model built for Mauritian Creole
note: the account is the operator chief executive's in an interview; no user count, evaluation or release detail is held

subject: tech.ai
name: Mauritius AI Registry
milestone: Live from 9 July 2026
position_end: Live as a discovery and trust directory of Mauritius-relevant models, agents and skills that does not host or sell what it lists, each entry carrying provider identity, local-context relevance and any institutional validation; the stack is open-sourced and is being offered to other operators (2026-07)

subject: tech.ai
name: National AI Strategy and FAIR guidelines
milestone: Build-not-buy position argued 2026-08-31
position_start: Did not exist; the strategy and its guidelines were published on 13 February 2026
position_end: Six pillars with guidelines that are vendor-neutral and border-agnostic, governing by impact rather than geography, carrying mandatory bias audits in financial services and gaming and locally-based-representative duties on foreign providers, non-binding but on a stated legal trajectory; a first AI Innovation Lab was inaugurated at Ebene Cybercity in August 2026 with a memorandum signed at the event, the strategy running 2025-2029 and the AI Unit established in December 2025
note: Both texts are held in their own right — the strategy and the non-binding fairness, accountability, inclusiveness and responsibility guidelines. The one binding artificial-intelligence instrument is the higher education regulations of April 2026.

subject: tech.ai
name: National sovereign compute capacity
note: Vendor or independent confirmation of installed accelerators. The state operator's chief executive stated in July 2026 that its data centre already hosts NVIDIA H200 units with B300 due by end-2026; no corroboration is on file, and this is precisely the compute-timing bet a domestic critique disputes.

subject: tech.ai
name: Public service digitalisation and AI readiness assessment
milestone: Section 15 of the 2026 pay research report
position_end: Published as a dedicated section of the 2026 pay research report, assessing digitalisation and artificial-intelligence readiness across conditions of service (2026)
note: A conditions-of-service review rather than a capability assessment; no readiness score is quoted.

subject: tech.ai
name: Sovereign AI platform and education pilot
milestone: Education pilot narrowed from student tutor to teacher assistant, stated 16 July 2026
position_end: In service as the operator's enterprise platform, with the school pilot deliberately narrowed after teacher and parent resistance from a student tutor to a teacher assistant doing homework correction and exam generation, targeting one per secondary teacher by 2027 (2026-07). The operator's chief executive set out a cloud partnership with a hyperscaler, sovereign data centres and a plan to train 50,000 people in artificial-intelligence skills, and put the education platform's exam-marking tools at 99% accuracy across the tools introduced
note: A rare documented narrowing of an African education deployment on pedagogical rather than technical grounds.

subject: tech.industry
name: ICT share of gross domestic product
milestone: Stated by the ICT minister, July 2026
position_end: About 5.4% of gross domestic product, against a stated ambition of 10-12% (2026-07)

subject: tech.innovate
name: Start-up and innovation ecosystem
milestone: Start-up measures carried in the 2026-2027 budget
position_start: An investment-promotion account of the innovation environment, with no dated programme
position_end: A start-up package carried in the 2026-2027 budget and an artificial-intelligence start-ups initiative showcased in May 2026 (2026-06)

subject: capacity.literacy
name: AI For All public awareness booklet
milestone: Launched by the President, 29 October 2025
position_end: Launched at the presidency as a general-population awareness publication on artificial intelligence (2025-10)
note: A booklet launch; no distribution or reach figure is published.

subject: capacity.literacy
name: Digital and AI capability in the civil service
milestone: Seminar on artificial intelligence held for civil servants, October 2025
position_start: The 2025-2029 blueprint naming public-service capability as a workstream
position_end: A seminar on artificial intelligence run for named civil servants in October 2025, and a public service and innovation institute established by Act in the same month (2025-10)

subject: capacity.literacy
name: Digital literacy of the population
milestone: Household ICT penetration and digital literacy reported in the annual ICT statistics
position_end: Measured annually through household ICT penetration indicators and a published digital literacy rate, with an awareness booklet launched at the presidency in October 2025 (2026-07)
note: A skills survey, a literacy programme evaluation or a national measure of digital competence. The 50,000-trainee target is an input commitment, not a measure of the base it starts from.

subject: capacity.training
name: National AI training programme
milestone: Target set in the 2026-2027 budget
position_end: A target of 50,000 people trained in one year — 25,000 professionals, 12,000 ninth-grade pupils, 8,000 teachers and 5,000 civil servants — on a Rs 25m platform; no completion or enrolment figure has been published (2026-06)

subject: capacity.training
name: Schools cybersecurity and AI awareness programme
milestone: Opened 2026-08-13 at the Mahatma Gandhi Institute
position_end: Running as a national awareness programme for secondary students, run by the incumbent operator with the education ministry, opening on 13 August 2026 with about 500 Grade 10 to Grade 12 students across all four education zones and free ten-hour AWS training on offer
note: an operator-run programme rather than a curriculum change; no full-year target, budget or evaluation is stated

subject: capacity.training
name: Tertiary provision in digital and AI subjects
milestone: AI modules taken to universities at the 2026 youth convention
position_start: Tertiary participation reported for 2024 with no digital-subject breakdown held
position_end: Artificial-intelligence modules taken to universities at the August 2026 youth convention, alongside an externally reviewed master's programme in data science and artificial intelligence (2026-08)

subject: capacity.research
name: Research institutions contributing to digital policy
milestone: Research and innovation institute established by Act, June 2026
position_start: An emerging technologies council provided for in a 2021 bill that the base cannot show was enacted
position_end: A national research and innovation institute established by Act in June 2026, and the higher education regulator issuing amended guidelines on the use of artificial intelligence in May (2026-06)

subject: include.access
name: Citizen support and reporting channels
milestone: Water leakage reporting added to the superapp, July 2026
position_start: A citizen support portal debated in the National Assembly in July 2025

subject: data.statistics
name: Central bank central statistical database
milestone: Portal launched 3 September 2026
position_end: A central statistical database of the central bank was launched on 3 September 2026 by the prime minister with the bank's governor on the bank's 59th anniversary. Developed with the International Monetary Fund and the African Development Bank, it opens statistical information to businesses, researchers, policymakers and citizens. The prime minister said a 2024 state of the economy report prompted the government to request a fund report on the observance of standards and codes, which underscored the need to strengthen statistical capacity and modernise dissemination, and that the statistics statute and the central bank statute are being reviewed to strengthen the statistical framework and reinforce central bank independence. The country graduated to the fund's special data dissemination standard in February 2012, the second sub-Saharan African country to do so, and adopted its enhanced tier in March 2026, the first African country to join it
note: no series list, update cadence, licence or machine-readable access route is stated for the portal, so how far it opens the data is not established
